references.text: He makes my feet like the deer's and sets me on my heights - both verses speak of God's strength and protection for the believer's journey.
Those who wait on the Lord shall renew their strength - the promise of renewed strength throughout life corresponds with the promise that power will last as long as days endure.
God promises to carry His people all the way into old age - the same theme of God's enduring care and strength throughout life.
He satisfies your life with good, so you are renewed like an eagle - the promise of renewal and strength through all the days of life.
My grace is sufficient for you, for power is perfected in weakness - God's power is given according to need, day by day.
Do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself - God gives strength day by day according to need.
With long life I will satisfy him and let him see my salvation - the promise of God's care and blessing throughout life.
